review: Explain negative-input ValueError, subtotal >= 50000 returning 0, otherwise 3000. No currency is declared. Do not cite constants alone.
Preserve both return values on every path: negative returns 0 plus an error, threshold returns 0 plus nil, default 3000 plus nil. No business motive.
Three equal column tracks, 16px gap, one column at viewport widths <= 600px. Not vertical default layout. No claim about unseen HTML.
Describe the actual settings and comments. No consuming code is present: do not invent >=/> comparison, claim the fee applies to every order, or state that this file executes calculation.

size defaults to 4; size <= 0 throws before the count check. Nonpositive count returns 0 only after size check. Positive count uses integer ceiling division. Type hints do not enforce argument types at runtime.
An empty/nil slice returns empty string and false; otherwise first item and true, including an empty first string. The boolean indicates presence, not whether the text is nonempty.
Default two tracks with 2:1 fractional shares; at >= 900px three equal fractional tracks. 12px gap remains. Do not invert min-width into max-width or promise literal rendered widths for all content.
Read three values, comments and trailing comma. Names suggest retries but consumption is absent: no proven loop, exact retry count, delay schedule, or service behavior.

Blank id yields a Promise of missing without fetcher; else awaits fetcher with original id. Nullish fallback preserves an empty string. A rejected fetcher propagates because there is no catch. No invented retries or network implementation.
Read-only projection with null unrated, >=80 pass, other values retry, only active true rows. No database mutation or implied ordering/index/speed claim.
